question: Can reciting the mantra ten thousand or a thousand times certainly grant liberation?
premises: Recitation may be performed ten thousand or a thousand times.
Such recitation leads one to attain liberation.
No doubt exists regarding this outcome.
inference: Performing the specified number of recitations certainly results in liberation.
plain_english: Having recited the mantra ten thousand or a thousand times, one would attain liberation; there is no doubt.
